description: Plannotator: plan review on ExitPlanMode's permission request. Where Claude Code runs hooks modules (interactive CLI sessions), the mod (mod/register.ts) makes plan review, annotate, code review and annotate-last non-blocking, unless the user turned it off (PLANNOTATOR_CLAUDE_MOD=0 or "claudeCodeMod": false in config.json); then the module passes every hook through.
